subject: Un-register notification and server event when RedisModule_OnLoad fails (#12809)
reason: The change fixes a real use-after-free in moduleLoad()'s OnLoad-failure branch (dangling keyspace-notification subscribers, server-event callbacks, command filters, and authenticated clients after the module struct is freed; moduleUnload() itself is only refactored, no behavior change). But the bug is only triggerable by a runtime MODULE LOAD <path> noload against a live server followed by commands that fire those callbacks, and no sanctioned fuzzer component can reach it: valkey.action.commands refuses MODULE LOAD/LOADEX/UNLOAD; module loading through the deployment or the commands action tak
